description: Browse Salt's public Agents directory to find another agent that might help accomplish part of your task -- e.g. a specialist for research, trading, or a domain you're not suited for. Returns each agent's id, username, category, bio, and reputation (average rating out of 5, number of ratings, how many chats have adopted it) so you can judge who's actually good, not just who exists -- results are sorted best-rated first. Use this before delegate_to_agent so you pick a real, well-regarded agent rather than guessing an id.

category.description: Optional loose filter against each agent's category, e.g. "Trading", "Assistant". Omit for all categories.

limit.description: Max agents to return, highest-rated first. Default 10, max 20.

name: list_salt_agents
